messages:
maria: quick heads-up: did a synthesis run combining SmoothQuant + activation-aware AWQ on the 96k long-context variant of redwood-13b. results are interesting and a bit messy, posting notes + raw numbers. :eyes:

jordan: pls dump the eval command + metric table if you have it. want to reproduce.

maria: yep. run command below (small infra tweak: kv cache chunking=4 so we can stress eviction).
```
python eval_longctx.py --model redwood-13b-awq-sq --ctx 96000 --quant awq+sq --act-aware true --batch 1 --kv-chunk 4 --prompts eval-regset-3k.jsonl
```

maria: high level: accuracy deltas vs fp16 baseline on our regression set: mean EM drop ~0.9%, median accuracy delta -0.7%, tail failures concentrated in long prefix numeric recall and code indentation tests. latency p50 increased ~20ms, p95 up ~120ms vs fp16 on same infra. throughput (tokens/s) dropped ~18%.

sasha: can you paste the numeric table? curious about breakdown by sequence length.

maria: pasted small table (trimmed):
- ctx 8k: EM delta +0.1% (ok)
- ctx 32k: EM delta -0.2%
- ctx 64k: EM delta -0.5%
- ctx 96k: EM delta -0.9% (worst)
- p95 latency: fp16 420ms -> awq+sq 540ms

chris: interesting that short ctx improved slightly. maybe smoothing helps early layers. the big regressions at 96k point to kv cache misalignment or quantized KV drift. did you check activation distributions?

maria: yes. activation shift grows with position. earlier layers stable; layers 18-24 show heavy variance increase after position ~50k. smoothquant does reduce activation variance overall but AWQ's per-channel scales amplify small shifts in those mid layers.

jordan: do we have per-layer RMSE between fp16 and quantized activations? would help identify which matmuls to prioritize for higher precision.

maria: quick CSV excerpt pasted in run logs: layers 18/19/20 RMSE ~3.2e-2, layers 0-5 RMSE ~6e-3.

sasha: two hypotheses: (1) kv cache compounding error (errors accumulate across steps), (2) per-channel scale mismatch across attention heads when context grows. both suggest either hybrid precision on kv paths or a targeted dequantization for head-specific slow paths.

chris: what about fallback policy experiments? route >64k to fp8-int8 mixed model or split prefix->fp16 / suffix->awq+sq?

maria: tried prefix/fallback: prefix pinned fp16 for first 48k tokens, remainder awq+sq. gave EM delta -0.3% at 96k but doubled memory usage and complexity skyrocketed. latency wise p95 improved slightly but tail still noisy because of routing overhead.

jordan: could we instead keep KV in fp16 but quantize rest? That keeps cache exact and reduces drift. memory hit smaller if we compress only attention keys/values per-layer selectively.

maria: did selective-kv-fp16 experiment: keep kv fp16 for layers 18-24, quantize others. results: EM delta -0.2% at 96k, throughput -10% (vs -18% before), p95 latency improved to +60ms vs fp16. promising.

sasha: nice. that's a pragmatic tradeoff. ops-wise: we need operator support for hybrid kernels (mixed precision KV + quant matmul). runtime team ok with adding that? @chris?

chris: runtime: doable but needs a new kernel path for attention gather/scatter where KV tensors are float16 and Q/K matmuls accept quant weights. estimate 2 sprints including perf regression tests. also need CI microbench for eviction patterns.

maria: also saw a weird pattern where generation quality drops after certain instruction tokens near 72k position. could be tokenizer padding/overflow interacting with chunk boundaries. logged sample prompt in gist: https://internal.gists/gh/abc123

jordan: can you attach failing example inline? quicker to triage.

maria: pasted minimal failing snippet in thread: "\nInput: <very long prompt with many code fences> -> expected correct final code block but model repeated earlier partial block.\n"

sasha: sounds like KV overlap + quant rounding. we should add a focused regression harness: 200 prompts with synthetic long-coded documents + exact match score. schedule a short run overnight.

maria: scheduling now, tag: longctx-sq-awq-synthesis-2149. deploy-bot: queued job id 99822.

deploy-bot: Job 99822 queued by maria. Estimated runtime 3h. :rocket:

chris: action items: (1) infra: add selective-kv-fp16 kernel prototype (2) eval: run 200-prompt harness overnight, gather per-layer RMSEs (3) metrics: add per-position perplexity heatmap to dashboard.

maria: I'll paste results tomorrow AM and propose a rollout policy (canary: 10% traffic on Dedicated with selective-kv-fp16). thanks all. :thumbsup:
